text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After running with all she's got and<n>crossing the
finish line, Mejiro Dober<n>realizes just how hard her
heart is<n>pounding.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her racing heart is proof of the<n>strength that
brought her victory and<n>the manifestation of her
powerful<n>wish to forge a new Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Having finally found herself, Mejiro<n>Dober once
again expresses her<n>desire to race against Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She sets her sights on the next race,<n>the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup, where<n>she seeks to defeat Air
Groove once<n>and for all!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But first, we set our sights on the<n>Fuchu
Umamusume Stakes!
